title: Osmotic Coefficients of Aqueous Sodium Chloride Solutions from 125 to 300 deg
authors: Chia-tsun Liu and W. T. Lindsay, Jr.
needs_pass2_reason: text layer clean; the only discrepancy was a glyph-reading ambiguity (0.809g in text layer) resolved to 0.8098 and a decimal comma 1076,47 -> 1076.47, both consistent with the image; no value changed
experimental_method: differential vapour pressure of solution vs pure water in two identical platinum/bellows cells in a thermostatted oil bath, balanced by helium gas pressure, 125-300 C, 0.1-1.0 m NaCl
uncertainties_stated: average deviation of osmotic coefficients of duplicate/triplicate ~1 m runs about +/-0.002 at low T up to +/-0.005 at 275 C and +/-0.006 at 300 C; differential pressure reproducibility about 0.1 mm; bath +/-0.001 C
quality_remarks: Poorest reproducibility at smallest vapour pressure lowering; 0.1 m 125 C results discarded by the authors; 0.1 m values at 150, 175, 200 C are averages of 2-3 runs (footnotes).
Printed small subscript digits (last significant digit) transcribed as ordinary digits.
Temperature scale not stated; pressure in Table I is mm Hg lowering only.

not_extracted_tables.reason: contributions of the three terms to the calculated osmotic coefficient (0.25 m): derived quantities

extraction_notes: Printed 'Osmotic coefficient at p = p0' is calculated by the authors from dp, hence derived_by_authors.
pass2_diff: Table I: 38 rows; every pass-2 number occurs in pass 1; the pass-1-only numbers are temperatures filled down on continuation rows.
